title: [Gemma4] Fix dtype casting for quantized vision/audio embedders (same as #46904)
author: sharmax-vikas

comments.author: zucchini-nlp
comments.body: Shouldn't be needed, we have `to(dtype)` all over vision-only model and it is mostly on input Conv proj, and afaik quant libs don't really target conv layers, The Gemma4 was more of a odd case since it is an encoder-less MLLM
